versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "否决/废标决策支持·专家版" (Bid Rejection Decision Support, Expert Version) skill.
- Provides structured decision support for bid rejection/clarification questions, triggered only when both a specific bidder's response and the corresponding tender clause are provided.
- Delivers clear outcomes: (1) rejection determination with legal/clause basis; (2) distinction between mandatory rejection and clarifiable deficiencies; (3) standardized wording for evaluation reports.
- Ensures accurate, well-founded, and defensible judgments, with built-in safeguards to stay within disciplinary and legal boundaries.
- Distinct from scanning, risk radar, or general Q&A—focused specifically on expert committee-side decision-making support.
